in_sanskrit.name: भूपति
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: भुः पतिः (bhūḥ patiḥ) - bhūḥ (bhūḥ) means 'earth' and patiḥ (patiḥ) means 'lord' or 'master'. Thus, Bhupati means 'Lord of the Earth'.

in_hindi.name: भूपति
in_hindi.long_meaning: भूपति (bhūpati) is a Hindi name which translates to 'Lord of the Earth'. The literal meaning is 'पृथ्वी (pṛthvī) के राजा (rājā)', which means 'king of the earth'.

in_tamil.name: பூபதி
in_tamil.long_meaning: பூபதி (būpadi) is a Tamil name which translates to 'Lord of the Earth'. The literal meaning is 'கொடிய (koṭi) இல்லங்காரியர் (illaṅkāriyar)', which means 'owner or master of the earth'.

in_telugu.name: బూపతి
in_telugu.long_meaning: బూపతి (būpati) is a Telugu name which translates to 'Lord of the Earth'. The literal meaning is 'మీదేశీ (mīdēśī)', which means 'master or god of the earth'.

in_marathi.name: Bhupati
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhupati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhupati is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'bhuh' meaning earth and 'pati' meaning lord. This name signifies someone who rules or governs over the earth and all its inhabitants. In Hindu mythology, Bhupati is also considered a name for Vishnu, the preserver god. The name is often used as a title for rulers and kings in Hindu tradition.
